item.title: Business News | Kisna Diamond and Gold Jewellery Changes Its Name to 'Radha Diamond and Gold Jewellery' for a Day to Honour Womanhood on Women's Day
item.description: Get latest articles and stories on Business at LatestLY. New Delhi [India], March 9: On the occasion of International Women's Day, Kisna Diamond and Gold Jewellery chose to mark the moment with a thoughtful and innovative tribute to womanhood, changing its name to 'Radha Diamond and Gold Jewellery' for a day in honour of the strength, compassion, grace and resilience that women embody.

item.title: Surat Shocker: 2 Women Found Dead in Gujarat Temple Washroom After Searching ‘Ways to Die’ on ChatGPT; Elon Musk Reacts
item.description: A shocking incident in Gujarat’s Surat has sparked debate over the use of artificial intelligence after two college students were found dead inside a temple washroom, with police claiming their phones contained searches on ChatGPT about methods of suicide.

item.title: Sports News | Lok Sabha Congratulates Team India After T20 World Cup 2026 Triumph
item.description: Get latest articles and stories on Sports at LatestLY. The Lok Sabha congratulated the Indian cricket team on lifting the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 trophy by defeating New Zealand in the final, which was held at Ahmedabad's Narendra Modi Stadium on Sunday. Lok Sabha Speaker Jagdambika Pal hailed the Men in Blue's win and noted that, with the World Cup win, they inspire Indian youth to dream big and achieve excellence in sports.

item.description: Get latest articles and stories on Business at LatestLY. item.title: Suryakumar Yadav, Head Coach Gautam Gambhir and ICC Chairman Jay Shah Visit Hanuman Temple in Ahmedabad After ICC T20 World Cup 2026 Win (Watch Video)
item.description: Hours after securing a historic third T20 World Cup title, India captain Suryakumar Yadav, head coach Gautam Gambhir, and International Cricket Council (ICC) chairman Jay Shah visited the Hanuman Temple in Ahmedabad to offer prayers. The trio was seen holding the T20 World Cup trophy as they sought blessings.

item.title: World News | India-Japan Joint Exercise Dharma Guardian 2026 Culminates
item.description: Get latest articles and stories on World at LatestLY. The seventh India-Japan military exercise, Dharma Guardian 2026, concluded in Chaubattia, Uttarakhand, on March 8. Focusing on counter-terrorism and urban warfare, the joint training enhanced interoperability and strategic ties. The exercise culminated in a successful 48-hour validation phase, reaffirming both nations' commitment to regional security and defence cooperation.
